tool_input.description: Restore all tracked files to their last committed state

result:
I attempted to run `git restore .` to discard changes to all tracked files, but the system has a rule preventing git discard operations.

**What I was trying to do:**
- Discard changes to the 3 tracked modified files (README.md, python-flask/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json, python-flask/.devcontainer/on-create-command.sh)
- Leave any untracked files untouched

**To proceed, you can:**
- Run `git restore .` locally to restore tracked files to their last committed state
- Or run `git checkout .` if you prefer the older syntax
- Or use `git reset --hard HEAD` to reset the entire working tree to the last commit

The Sentinel rule is designed to prevent accidental data loss, so it requires human confirmation for this action.
